text: “Interview Video” Rubric 1. Interview Image (10 points) The student frames the video of the subject in a visually compelling shot that uses the guidelines explained in the online module (rule of thirds, camera off center from subject, appropriate headroom and camera distance). 2. Cutaway Images (10 points) The student chooses appropriate cutaway footage that illustrates the story. The footage is visually compelling with appropriate camera distances and angles. 3. Editing (10 points) The interview and cutaways are edited together with the cutaways appearing at an appropriate moment in the interview. The audio from the interview is detached from the video and continues playing under the cutaway footage. 4. Audio (10 points) The audio from the interview is clear and at an appropriate volume level. The interviewer’s questions do not appear in the video, simply presenting the subject’s responses. Total:
